rationale.edition: All 54 changed files live under standard OSS paths (src/, web/src/) — none under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/. No enterprise keywords (SSO, SAML, RBAC, SDR, cipher, logo-management) appear in the changed paths, and the Cargo.lock delta only lists o2_enterprise as a dependency of other crates consuming it, not as a changed source path. Edition is oss.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The diff includes user-facing Vue component changes (AddTemplate.vue, ContentFieldsEditor.vue, Login.vue, form components, log plugins) and no explicit skip marker (trigger_comment.txt and feature_hint.txt are both empty; no 'tests-added' label). The change is not docs-only or CI-only.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The PR introduces client-side link URL validation in the alert template editor (save-time toast + inline error on the ContentFieldsEditor link input) and a login redirect security fix (isSameOriginRedirect replacing an unsafe substring check). Both are user-interaction flows that need verification: saving a template with a hostile link URL (javascript:, data:, bare host) should show a clear inline error and block the save; the login page must refuse an off-origin redirectURI. The backend hardening (link_scheme_is_allowed validate, dispatchable_url) is also user-visible through the preview/save error messages.
rationale.area: Alerts is the dominant area. The bulk of new code (contentSpec link validation, preview validation, dispatchable_url in renderers) and the primary frontend changes (AddTemplate.vue save validation, ContentFieldsEditor.vue inline error, contentSpec.ts linkUrlBadScheme) all live in the alerts/template domain. The ancillary changes in logs, dashboards, cross-linking, and login are improvements that consume the shared safeUrl utility but are not the primary feature.
rationale.group: Alerts is an existing CI matrix group referenced in ci_matrix.ent.json (disabled section lists alerts-anomaly-detection.spec.js and alerts-deduplication-regression.spec.js). The spec tests alert template editing and validation, which fits naturally in this shard.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E Playwright specs in the diff. The changed test files (AddTemplate.spec.ts, ContentFieldsEditor.spec.ts, contentSpec.spec.ts, safeUrl.spec.ts, Login.spec.ts, etc.) are all Vitest unit tests under web/src/ — they are dev-authored unit coverage, not E2E Playwright specs, and do not signal existing E2E coverage for the new feature.
